violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed staff rinse hands and at the hand sink and then dry his hands on his apron.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO WASH HIS HANDS WITH HOT WATER AND SOAP AND TO USE PAPER TOWELS TO DRY HIS HANDS. STAFF WASHED HIS HANDS ACCORDINGLY.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed the blade of the can opener with accumulated debris
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC TOOK THE CAN OPENER TO THE DISH MACHINE TO BE WASHED AND SANITIZED. CAN OPENER WAS LATER OBSERVED CLEAN.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) roasted potatoes were observed at 88f. Potatoes were observed being stored under the stove top burners.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. STAFF BEGAN REHEATING POTATOES IN THE OVEN TO 165f. HOT FOOD MUST REMAIN AT 135F OR HIGHER. KEEP POTATOES IN OVEN FOR PROPER HOT HOLDING. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. ENSURE THERE IS A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT ALL HOURS OF FOOD PREPARATION. OUR MOM EUGENIA (Inspection Date: 03/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed an uncovered small to-go containers of coffee being stored on a shelf above the prep sink. Observed a water bottle being stored on top of a working stack of plates at the 3DR prep top.
violations.corrective_action: STAFF MEMBER DISCARDED THE COFFEE. OTHER STAFF MEMBER MOVED THE WATER BOTTLE TO A DIFFERENT LOCATION THAT WILL NOT CONTAMINATE FOOD, UTENSILS, EQUIPMENT, OR SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS. USE BEVERAGES CONTAINERS WITH LIDS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WRITE THE DATE WHEN THE LAST PIECE OF SHELLSTOCK WAS SOLD ON ITS CORRESPONDING TAG. RETAIN FOR 90 DAYS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) In the 1DR lowboy cooler, Raw calamari and Raw shrimp was observed being stored above soup
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. STAFF MEMBER MOVED THE RAW CALAMARI AND RAW SHRIMP TO THE BOTTOM SHELF OF THE COOLER. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. STAFF MEMBER BEGAN REHEATING THE LAMB SHANKS IN THE OVEN TO 165f.

violations.title: Cold Holding

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The interior of the ice machine was observed with pink and brown discoloration.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: A squeeze bottle of alcohol was observed on a prep table without a label.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC LABELED THE BOTTLE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) 1DR under counter cooler next to the fryer; 2) 1DR prep top cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE PLACE A THERMOMETER IN EACH OF THE COOLERS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed packed raw animal protein being stored directly on the floor of the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ALL FOODS NEED TO BE ELEVATED OFF THE FLOOR. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
